stories.headline: Another SOUTHCOM strike on an eastern Pacific speedboat kills five as the campaign passes 70 strikes
stories.summary: On 27 October, US Southern Command struck a go-fast boat on what it called established trafficking routes in the eastern Pacific, killing all five aboard; no drugs were recovered…
